newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Up to 10 children die in Estonia crash-agency. [CORRECTED 20:49 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Up to 10 children die in Estonia crash-agency. [CORRECTED 20:49 GMT]

text.p: Up to 10 children were killed in Estonia on Friday after their bus crashed head-on into a lorry, the Baltic News Service (BNS) reported.

The news agency quoted a witness to the crash saying that around 10 children were killed in the accident. A police spokesman told Reuters at least eight people, mostly children, died in the accident, which took place in central Estonia.
BNS said the accident took place near the small settlement of Pala (corrects spelling) in the Joegeva district, in east central Estonia, some 160 km (100 miles) from the capital Tallinn.
It quoted Raivo Vadi, head of the Pala (corrects from Joegeva) administration, as saying he saw around 10 dead children, possibly more. He said the driver of the lorry was also probably dead.
"It was a terrible scene," the agency quoted him as saying.
BNS said the children were returning from a sports event when the accident took place. Vaido said some children told him the lorry was swerving from one side of the road to the other.
